title: RiskStrategy
description: A risk prioritisation strategy: an ordered list of rules that puts every open finding in a priority tier. A finding's tier is the position of the first rule it matches, 0 being the highest priority. A tenant may keep several strategies; one is active, and a tenant with none active uses the system default.

metadata.description: metadata.name is stored as the strategy's name.

active.description: Make this the tenant's active strategy. Activating one deactivates the others, so at most one document in a set should say true.

rules.description: The rules in priority order: the first is tier 0. Exactly one REMAINING rule is required, and it belongs last, where it catches every finding no earlier rule matched.

label.description: The tier's name in the console. Defaults to the metric and operator.

metric.description: What the rule tests. Present-or-not signals: MALWARE; KEV_CISA, KEV_ENISA, KEV_VULNETIX, KEV_VULNCHECK (in that known-exploited catalogue); EXPLOIT_WEAPONIZED, EXPLOIT_ACTIVE, EXPLOIT_POC; INTERNET_EXPOSED_PACKAGE (the package was seen on a publicly reachable cloud resource of the repository); INTERNET_EXPOSED (the repository has a publicly reachable cloud resource); REACHABLE and UNREACHABLE (SCA reachability, assessed); TRACEABLE (resolves to a file and lines); TRACEABLE_GRAPH (traceable, and the file is called in the repository graph); ATTACK_PATH (matches attackPathId). Scores: CVSS and CWSS (the effective score, an analyst override preferred), CUSTOM_CVSS and CUSTOM_CWSS (the override only), CESS (0 to 10), EPSS (0 to 1). REMAINING matches everything. CEL matches when the when expression is true.

operator.description: IS_TRUE for a present-or-not metric. GTE, GT, LTE and LT compare a score with thresholdLow; BETWEEN tests thresholdLow <= score <= thresholdHigh. ALWAYS matches everything, for REMAINING.

attackPathId.description: ATTACK_PATH only, and required there: the attack path the rule matches.

when.description: The condition of a CEL rule, over the finding variables. Not stored yet: the CEL metric and the nullable expr column on RiskPrioritizationRule do not exist until the CEL work adds them.
